_meta.purpose: Bootstrap current Wild Rift champion numeric data into a structured JSON so remaining gaps can be completed manually or by a future scraper.
important_limitations: This is a bootstrap gameplay dataset, not an official Riot canonical database.
WildRiftFire is used as a third-party fallback baseline for current champion numeric data.
Official Riot patch-note deltas remain authoritative where conflicts exist.
Values with malformed or ambiguous third-party source formatting are left partial and explicitly flagged rather than guessed.
Manual in-game verification is still recommended before treating the dataset as production-canonical.
